name: andreys-helper
description: Worktree controls in the Source Control panel for VSCode and Cursor, driving the worktrunk (wt) CLI headlessly — create and remove git worktrees without touching the terminal.

enumDescriptions: Patch the installed Claude Code extension to enable worktree-scoped tabs and default the auto-include-file toggle off.
Revert the Claude Code extension to its original, unpatched state (restores the pre-patch backup).
andreysHelper.claudeCodePatch.markdownDescription: One-shot action to **patch or unpatch** the installed Claude Code bundle from within this extension — no shell script needed. Pick **Patch** or **Unpatch**; it runs, offers to restart the extension host to apply, then resets to *No change* (the actual patch state lives in the Claude bundle, not here). Safe to re-run and reversible.

andreysHelper.startupPanes.markdownDescription: Automatically arrange Claude panes to this many columns when a window finishes starting up, replacing the restored layout. `0` disables it (default). The editor restores its previous layout first and this then re-arranges into the chosen column count — opening fresh Claude sessions if the window restored with none. Equivalent to pressing **C1/C2/C3** on startup.

andreysHelper.closeCursorAgent.markdownDescription: When arranging Claude panes (C1/C2/C3), close Cursor's built-in agent first so it doesn't compete for editor space. Closes both shapes it takes — a webview editor matching `#andreysHelper.cursorAgentViewTypePattern#` and its blank-input editor tab. Claude tabs are webviews and never affected.

andreysHelper.cursorAgentViewTypePattern.markdownDescription: Case-insensitive regular expression matched against editor webview `viewType`s to identify Cursor's agent/chat tab for closing. Claude's own tabs are always excluded. Use the **Claude Panes: Inspect Tabs (debug)** command to discover the real viewType. Requires `#andreysHelper.closeCursorAgent#`.

andreysHelper.watchIncoming.enabled.markdownDescription: Watch each open repo/worktree for **incoming commits** (what Sync would pull) that touch files matching `#andreysHelper.watchIncoming.patterns#`. While matches exist, the Source Control tree icon turns red; click it to list the files and open their incoming diffs.

andreysHelper.watchIncoming.patterns.markdownDescription: Glob patterns matched against the repo-relative paths of incoming changed files. Prefix a pattern with `!` to exclude. Defaults to Django migrations; add any file or directory you want to be warned about before syncing (e.g. `config/settings.py`, `package-lock.json`).

andreysHelper.watchIncoming.fetchOnFocus.markdownDescription: Run one throttled `git fetch` per repo when the window regains focus, so the incoming-change indicator is fresh before you press Sync. Between focuses, detection rides on the git extension's own autofetch — no polling timer.

andreysHelper.watchIncoming.focusFetchTh.markdownDescription: Minimum seconds between focus-triggered fetches per repo. Requires `#andreysHelper.watchIncoming.fetchOnFocus#`.

andreysHelper.scmBranchInfo.enabled.markdownDescription: Compute per-worktree info (ahead/behind the window's trunk, whether uncommitted or diverging changes touch a migration) and show it on each repo row of the **Andrey's Helper → Source Control+** pane.

andreysHelper.scmBranchInfo.migrationGlo.markdownDescription: Glob patterns (minimatch, `!` to exclude) matched against a worktree's files that diverge from trunk — committed divergence plus uncommitted working-tree changes. When any match, the branch-info line shows a migration warning. Empty disables the check.
